mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM sys_role_permission rp JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id=#{roleId} AND rp.deleted=FALSE ORDER BY p.id
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_role_permission SET deleted=TRUE WHERE role_id=#{roleId} AND permission_id=#{permissionId} AND deleted=FALSE
UPDATE sys_role SET version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} WHERE id=#{roleId} AND version=#{version} AND deleted=FALSE
